howto.what: 让 NanoClaw 能接入微软 Teams。它自动复制和注册适配器、安装依赖，用命令行建好机器人并保存凭据，最后给你一个安装链接。
howto.when: 当你要求把微软 Teams 加到 NanoClaw，例如说“加 Teams 频道”或“接微软 Teams”时。

say.text: 把微软 Teams 接到 NanoClaw 上
say.note: 自动跑完整个接入流程

say.text: 让 NanoClaw 支持 Teams 群聊和私信
say.note: 建好机器人并给安装链接

say.text: 接入 Teams 频道，机器人叫 NanoBot
say.note: 用这个名字创建 Teams 机器人

howto.what_en: Adds Microsoft Teams channel support to NanoClaw. Copies and registers the adapter, installs the dependency, provisions a bot via the Teams CLI, saves credentials, and provides an install link to add the app.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to connect NanoClaw with Microsoft Teams, e.g. 'add Teams channel' or 'connect Microsoft Teams'.

say_en.text: Let NanoClaw support Teams group chats and DMs
say_en.note: Creates a bot and gives an install link

say_en.text: Add Teams channel and name the bot NanoBot
say_en.note: Creates the bot under that name
